proposed_compliance_gate.note: Wired to --ci: --ci requires measurement well-formedness AND (a) every non-conditional axiom passes every cycle, (b) no non-conditional axiom appears in any failing set, and (c) a conditional axiom (Λ4.11) still passes on at least one cycle (never always-false). High-diversity standard-mode cycles may legitimately fail 4.11; that is recorded, not smoothed.

4.11.evidence: Λ4.11's corrected reading matches its lens architecture: the DistributedCouncil crew re-scores ONE primary decision through N role lenses, so group_utility is a consensus (weighted mean ≤ the best lens) — NOT a summable total and NOT strict superadditivity. Because mean ≤ max and C_align ≥ 0, the strict predicate (group − C_align >= isolated) holds exactly at zero measured divergence; any divergence legitimately fails it. The live md-cap cycle is the signature — every role DI is 1.0, but one conservative validation-axis dissent gives diversity 0.4 (C_align 0.24), so group−C_align = 0.76 < isolated = 1.0. This is a recorded conditional outcome, NOT a wiring gap: the not-applicable record for a skipped crew is unchanged and the axiom remains falsifiable (the 4.11 sabotager flips it).
